# Hero photograph

The active hero image is `laptop.png`, supplied for this site. `forest-window-laptop.jpg` is an alternative free [Pexels photo by Ron Lach](https://www.pexels.com/photo/a-laptop-on-wooden-surface-9222423/).

To replace the photograph, change the `href` on `.hero-photo` in the root `index.html`. The `hero-rounded-photo` clip keeps its complete rounded outline, while the second image and `hero-frame-mask` preserve the decorative curve and leaves.
